lesson_intent.one_sentence_goal: Practice nuanced reaction language with even if and not quite.
lesson_intent.real_life_context: Discussing a book, series, or podcast that was interesting but imperfect.
lesson_intent.communicative_function: Expressing mixed reactions and explaining a limitation without sounding negative.

dialogue_task.scenario: Anna and Erik discuss a podcast episode that had an interesting topic but was not fully convincing.

main_focus.name: nuanced concession with även om
main_focus.description: Use även om to keep a positive and negative reaction in the same thought.
model_examples: Även om ämnet var intressant blev avsnittet lite långt.
Jag gillade tonen, även om argumenten inte riktigt höll.
main_focus.desired_presence: Use även om naturally 3-4 times in the dialogue.

allowed_supporting_grammar: hedging with lite, ganska, inte riktigt
evaluation frames from earlier in the week
reported opinion with jag uppfattade det som att

vocabulary_target.desired_presence: Use evaluation vocabulary that lets the reaction sound balanced and adult.

dialogue_shape.opening: They introduce a media item and give a mixed first reaction.
dialogue_shape.middle: They mention what was interesting, what was less convincing, and how tone affected the impression.
dialogue_shape.ending: They decide whether the media item is still worth recommending.

target_complexity.repetition: även om and hedging phrases should appear enough for useful practice

focus: the mixed reaction to the media item
the limitation that makes the reaction less positive
the final recommendation and its reason

sentence_focus: one sentence describing an argument as convincing or not convincing
one sentence about tone or impression
one sentence giving a balanced recommendation
